title: Which ground shakes more?
question: Rock ground or sand ground: which one shakes more?
steps: Pull the red handle to the left and let go: the shake table shakes.
The farther you pull, the harder it shakes.
Use the buttons at the bottom left to pick the ground and the house's brace.
observe: With the same shake, soft sand ground shakes more than hard rock ground. A house with a slanted brace between its posts does not lean over easily, so it stands.

terms.name: Earthquake
terms.description: The ground shaking when a big force stored deep underground lets go all at once.

terms.name: Earthquake-proof building
terms.description: Building a house strong, with braces and such, so it stands when an earthquake comes.

law.title: Ground and shaking
law.description: A shake starts in one place and spreads out all around like ripples. With the same shake, soft sand ground sways more. A house built strong with braces stands even a big shake.

tip: Press the red handle, pull it to the left and let go. The farther you pull, the harder the table shakes. After a shake, press the handle again and the house stands up again.
tip_short: Pull the handle and let go

predict.question: Rock ground or sand ground: which one shakes more?
predict.reason: Sand ground is soft and wobbly. So the same earthquake shakes it more.
predict.bridge: Shake it and see for yourself!

stages.text: Shake the hard rock ground just a little!
stages.say: A small shake, and the house can stand. Hard rock ground shakes less.

stages.text: Just as little, now shake the soft sand ground!
stages.say: The same shake moves soft sand ground more than rock ground. So the house with no brace fell down.
stages.win: Crash! It fell on the sand!

stages.text: Put in the brace and keep the house standing in the biggest shake!
stages.say: A slanted brace between the posts holds the house tight so it does not lean over. Building like this to stand earthquakes is called **earthquake-proof building**. See where the ripple stripes on the ground come from, and you know where the shake started.

story.keeper: This is the squirrels' village. That night the ground shook and the houses cracked. What if it shakes again…
story.clue: The squirrels must have been so scared…

more.text: Oh, there's a piece on the hill behind the village! The houses must be strong so we can get there safely.

story.map_clue: At the end of the valley, where the block house stands!

kid.intro: This is the earthquake lab. When a big force stored deep underground lets go all at once, the ground shakes. This is called an **earthquake**.

intro_more.text: A shake starts in one place and spreads out all around like ripples. Pull the shake table and let go, and it shakes like an earthquake.

kid.title: Pull the shake table, let go, and see if the house stands!
kid.say: Soft sand ground shakes more than rock ground. A house with a brace stands well.
kid.tip: Pull the handle and let go.

note.law: A shake starts in one place and spreads out all around. Soft ground shakes more, and a house with a brace stands well.
